summary: Digimarc Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing entry into Purchase Agreements for a registered direct offering of 4,500,000 common shares at $4.04 per share, grossing approximately $18.2 million, expected to close on or about September 30, 2026. Net proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes. Investors receive offering participation rights for three years, terminating earlier if the Company achieves positive EBIT and operating cash flow over two consecutive quarters. A lock-up restricts further issuance through December 31, 2026. This is a capital-raising event, though not a special situation per the defined categories.
